Description

Imerza is a global digital twin consultancy partnering with visionary placemakers - developers, architects, and brands - to visualize complex information and data across every stage of the development lifecycle. From concepting to closing and beyond, we deliver measurable value through immersive intelligence: transforming raw geospatial and project data into powerful, real-time 3D environments that drive better decisions.

- Lead and manage all GIS technical deliverables across multiple projects, ensuring timely, high-quality outputs aligned with client requirements and company standards.
- Oversee the full GIS workflow, from data acquisition and processing to final integration into immersive environments.
- Maintain strict adherence to standardised data structures, schemas, naming conventions, and metadata protocols for all geospatial datasets.
- Develop, implement, and enforce best-practice GIS data management policies to ensure consistency, accuracy, and scalability.
- Perform advanced geospatial data processing, cleaning, transformation, and quality assurance using ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar platforms.
- Prepare and optimise GIS datasets (vector, raster, elevation/DEM, 3D features, and attribute data) for ingestion into Unreal Engine.
- Utilise Unreal Engine tools and plugins (e.g. ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine) to import, geo-reference, and integrate GIS data into real-time 3D environments and digital twins.
- Collaborate closely with Unreal Engine developers, 3D artists, and visualisation teams to troubleshoot geospatial integration issues (coordinate systems, scale, precision, performance optimisation).
- Ensure geospatial accuracy, coordinate reference system alignment, and visual fidelity when translating GIS data into Unreal Engine scenes.
- Manage version control, backups, and archiving of GIS datasets to support project iteration and long-term asset reuse.
- Document GIS processes, data pipelines, and Unreal Engine ingestion workflows to facilitate team knowledge sharing and onboarding.
- Identify and implement opportunities to automate GIS-to-Unreal data pipelines for increased efficiency on large-scale projects.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior GIS team members on data standards, Unreal integration techniques, and project-specific requirements.
- Research and source GIS datasets to support world-building teams.
- Stay current with advancements in GIS technologies, game-engine geospatial tools, and emerging best practices for immersive digital twin development.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:

- Proven senior-level experience in GIS data management, processing, and analysis.
- Deep proficiency with ArcGIS, QGIS, or comparable GIS platforms.
- Hands-on experience integrating GIS data into Unreal Engine, including familiarity with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine or similar geospatial game-engine plugins.
- Strong understanding of coordinate reference systems, projections, and geospatial accuracy requirements.
- Experience preparing and optimising vector, raster, DEM/elevation, and 3D feature datasets for real-time 3D environments.
- Ability to develop and enforce data standards, schemas, and documentation across teams.
- Experience with pipeline automation and scripting (Python or similar) for GIS data workflows.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills
- comfortable working cross-functionally with 3D artists, developers, and project managers.
- Experience managing and mentoring junior team members.

Nice to Have:

- Background in real estate, architecture, urban planning, or related property development industries.
- Familiarity with digital twin platforms and immersive visualisation pipelines.
- Experience with game engines beyond Unreal Engine (e.g. Unity).
- Knowledge of BIM data and its integration with GIS environments.

What We Offer

- A globally distributed, collaborative team at the cutting edge of immersive technology.
- Exposure to high-profile, visionary real estate and placemaking projects worldwide.
- The opportunity to shape GIS best practices and build scalable workflows in an innovative, fast-growing consultancy.
- Flexible, remote-first working environment.

About the Inventory Planning Data Analyst Position

The Inventory Planning Data Analyst is responsible for the data, analytics, and forecasting that drive Washington Shoe Company’s inventory decisions. The analyst owns replenishment planning for Amazon and our other replenishment customers, executes seasonal buys, and manages the company’s item performance metric (the M Score) to keep top-selling items in stock and to identify underperforming items for exit. The role builds and maintains the data foundation for planning using our ERP (Ai2000/Oracle), SQL, Excel, and Power BI, and builds a machine learning forecasting tool and AI-assisted planning tools using Claude. The company operates an on-premises NVIDIA DGX Spark, giving the analyst dedicated local GPU compute to train and run forecasting models and AI agents against company data. The analyst reports to the Director of Production Operations and works closely with Sales, eCommerce, Sourcing, and Logistics.

The company’s inventory targets for this position are an 80% fill rate and an inventory turn of 4 on an annualized basis.

Role and Responsibilities

Data, Analytics & AI

•     Build and maintain the data foundation for inventory planning: pull, join, and validate data from the ERP (Ai2000/Oracle), customer portals, and SharePoint using SQL, Excel, and Power BI.
•     Build a machine learning forecasting tool for replenishment items; measure forecast accuracy against actuals and improve the model over time.
•     Design and build an AI planning agent using Claude to automate routine planning work, including weekly data pulls, exception flagging, draft purchase order recommendations, and customer-ready reporting.
•     Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and standard reports covering fill rate, in-stock rate, weeks of supply, inventory turns, aged inventory, and forecast accuracy.
•     Prepare clear, concise analysis and recommendations for Sales, eCommerce, and leadership; present findings in a form that supports decisions.
•     Document data sources, models, and planning processes so they are repeatable and can be maintained by others.

Replenishment and Seasonal Planning

•     Own replenishment planning for Amazon and our other replenishment customers: maintain item- and size-level forecasts, set target weeks of supply and safety stock, and place timely purchase orders to achieve the company’s 80% fill rate target without overstocking.
•     Plan seasonal buys by season and customer, aligning quantities and size curves to customer projections and historical sell-through, and working backward from vendor lead times and required in-stock dates.
•     Review demand signals weekly, including customer point-of-sale data, Amazon Vendor Central, open orders, and on-hand inventory, and act on stockouts, overstocks, and forecast misses.
•     Coordinate with Sourcing, Production, and Logistics on lead times, capacity, and delivery timing.

M Score and Assortment Management

•     Maintain and review the M Score, the company’s item performance metric, and use it to rank items for backfill, hold, or exit.
•     Proactively reorder high-performing items so they remain in stock throughout their selling window.
•     Identify underperforming items and recommend exit strategies (markdown, channel shift, or discontinuation) to the Sales and eCommerce teams, supported by data.
•     Track the results of backfill and exit decisions and incorporate findings into the next planning cycle.
Other Duties

•     Support Operations and Production with ad-hoc analysis and reporting.
•     Reconcile customer-specific inventory positions as needed.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

•     Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

•     Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and Power Query.
•     Experience building reports or dashboards in Power BI or a comparable BI tool.
•     Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude in day-to-day analytical work, and a demonstrated interest in applying AI to automate and improve processes.
•     Strong attention to detail and the ability to validate data and explain the reasoning behind a recommendation.
•     Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present data clearly to sales, eCommerce, and leadership audiences.

The Children and Youth With Special Health Care Needs (CYSHCN) Program Coordinator performs advanced consultative services and technical work related to planning, developing, and implementing systems of care for CYSHCN and their families. About the Inventory Planning Data Analyst Position

The Inventory Planning Data Analyst is responsible for the data, analytics, and forecasting that drive Washington Shoe Company’s inventory decisions. The analyst owns replenishment planning for Amazon and our other replenishment customers, executes seasonal buys, and manages the company’s item performance metric (the M Score) to keep top-selling items in stock and to identify underperforming items for exit. The role builds and maintains the data foundation for planning using our ERP (Ai2000/Oracle), SQL, Excel, and Power BI, and builds a machine learning forecasting tool and AI-assisted planning tools using Claude. The company operates an on-premises NVIDIA DGX Spark, giving the analyst dedicated local GPU compute to train and run forecasting models and AI agents against company data. The analyst reports to the Director of Production Operations and works closely with Sales, eCommerce, Sourcing, and Logistics.

The company’s inventory targets for this position are an 80% fill rate and an inventory turn of 4 on an annualized basis.

Role and Responsibilities

Data, Analytics & AI

•     Build and maintain the data foundation for inventory planning: pull, join, and validate data from the ERP (Ai2000/Oracle), customer portals, and SharePoint using SQL, Excel, and Power BI.
•     Build a machine learning forecasting tool for replenishment items; measure forecast accuracy against actuals and improve the model over time.
•     Design and build an AI planning agent using Claude to automate routine planning work, including weekly data pulls, exception flagging, draft purchase order recommendations, and customer-ready reporting.
•     Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and standard reports covering fill rate, in-stock rate, weeks of supply, inventory turns, aged inventory, and forecast accuracy.
•     Prepare clear, concise analysis and recommendations for Sales, eCommerce, and leadership; present findings in a form that supports decisions.
•     Document data sources, models, and planning processes so they are repeatable and can be maintained by others.

Replenishment and Seasonal Planning

•     Own replenishment planning for Amazon and our other replenishment customers: maintain item- and size-level forecasts, set target weeks of supply and safety stock, and place timely purchase orders to achieve the company’s 80% fill rate target without overstocking.
•     Plan seasonal buys by season and customer, aligning quantities and size curves to customer projections and historical sell-through, and working backward from vendor lead times and required in-stock dates.
•     Review demand signals weekly, including customer point-of-sale data, Amazon Vendor Central, open orders, and on-hand inventory, and act on stockouts, overstocks, and forecast misses.
•     Coordinate with Sourcing, Production, and Logistics on lead times, capacity, and delivery timing.

M Score and Assortment Management

•     Maintain and review the M Score, the company’s item performance metric, and use it to rank items for backfill, hold, or exit.
•     Proactively reorder high-performing items so they remain in stock throughout their selling window.
•     Identify underperforming items and recommend exit strategies (markdown, channel shift, or discontinuation) to the Sales and eCommerce teams, supported by data.
•     Track the results of backfill and exit decisions and incorporate findings into the next planning cycle.
Other Duties

•     Support Operations and Production with ad-hoc analysis and reporting.
•     Reconcile customer-specific inventory positions as needed.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

•     Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

•     Working proficiency in SQL, including joins and aggregations against a relational database.
•     Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and Power Query.
•     Experience building reports or dashboards in Power BI or a comparable BI tool.
•     Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude in day-to-day analytical work, and a demonstrated interest in applying AI to automate and improve processes.
•     Strong attention to detail and the ability to validate data and explain the reasoning behind a recommendation.
•     Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present data clearly to sales, eCommerce, and leadership audiences.
